title: lastrea coniifolia
intro: Lastrea coniifolia, commonly known as the Maidenhair Fern, is a species of fern found in tropical Asia. It has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, including its ability to lower blood pressure, improve digestion, and boost the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Lastrea coniifolia include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which make it useful in treating various conditions such as fever, cough, and skin irritations. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, saponins, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
